acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing a reliable plumber for bathtub repair involves considering several factors. Look for plumbers with positive local reviews, clear licensing and insurance, and a track record of experience with bathtub-specific issues. It's advisable to get written estimates, ask about their warranty on parts and labor, and ensure they serve your specific area.
